QuestInfo.name: [Geardock] Floor B2
QuestInfo.0: Kelly tinkers with the suspicious machine and opens a secret passageway beneath the sands. Speak to Kelly about what to do next.
QuestInfo.1:
Kelly believes Gob created the machines in the underground facility and urges the group to investigate further.

Defeat 100 #o8645481# enemies in #m410013703#.
